Usage: aipass vault [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  status
  change-password
  rotate
  devices
  revoke-device
  export
  import
  help             Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --json
      --vault <VAULT>        [env: AIPASS_VAULT_DIR=]
      --password <PASSWORD>  [env: AIPASS_MASTER_PASSWORD=]
  -h, --help                 Print help
